context: The barista and an elderly neighbor discuss running a small shop
purpose: Teach: 鍋/容量/汚れ/売り上げ/取り組む/定着/装備/求人

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 葵ちゃん、最近お店の売り上げはどう？
lines.en: Aoi-chan, how have the shop's sales been lately?
lines.style: Warm elderly tone, caring neighborly inquiry, gentle pacing

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おかげさまで少しずつ伸びてます。今は新メニューに取り組むところなんです。
lines.en: Thanks to you, it's growing little by little. Right now I'm working on a new menu.
lines.style: Bright cheerful barista voice, polite but warm professional tone

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: あら素敵ね。大きな鍋でスープでも仕込むの？
lines.en: Oh how lovely. Are you preparing soup in a big pot?
lines.style: Curious elderly grandmother tone, soft inviting interest

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ええ、業務用の容量が大きいものを買おうか迷ってて。
lines.en: Yes, I'm debating whether to buy a commercial one with bigger capacity.
lines.style: Thoughtful barista voice, slightly hesitant practical reasoning

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 古いお鍋だと油汚れもひどいでしょうし、思い切って装備を整えたら？
lines.en: Old pots get terribly greasy, so why not invest in proper equipment?
lines.style: Wise elderly advice tone, encouraging maternal warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そうですね。それにアルバイトの求人も出そうと思ってるんです。
lines.en: You're right. I'm also thinking of posting a job ad for part-timers.
lines.style: Determined barista voice, planning aloud with clear resolve

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 人が定着してくれるといいわね。最近は若い子がすぐ辞めちゃうから。
lines.en: I hope your staff stick around. Young people quit so quickly these days.
lines.style: Concerned elderly tone, gentle worldly observation, soft sigh

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に。だから働きやすい環境作りから真剣に取り組みます。
lines.en: Truly. That's why I'll seriously work on building a comfortable workplace first.
lines.style: Earnest barista voice, firm committed professional resolve
